gen-audiowide-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads tall and tidy, a lofty lowercase band that feels modern. Ubuntu's plain sans calm meets Audiowide's tile-like glyphs, which have no hairlines and no swells anywhere.
gen-audiowide-gf-victor-mono: Audiowide's glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines, futuristic and stroke-uniform. Victor Mono counters with a monospace body of loose spacing, magnified-looking text and bowls left open on one side.
gen-audiowide-gf-viga:
Audiowide brings the futuristic, tech-flavored lettering up top.

Viga follows in a plain sans with no hairlines or shadows in its strokes, so the pair feels like a sleek machine paired with a quiet, professional assistant.
gen-audiowide-gf-voces:
Futuristic and ruler-straight, Audiowide draws every line like compass work.

Voces underneath is a plain sans with tall lowercase and a slight swell on its bowls, while Audiowide earns its keep when big and short.
gen-audiowide-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough reads in a sans-serif body that nearly matches its capitals in height, which feels contemporary. And Audiowide's crossbars are as thick as its stems, so a slightly larger heading size would let that chunky, tech look stand out.
gen-audiowide-gf-winky-sans:
Audiowide draws each glyph with one monoweight stroke, like futuristic tiles separated by wide grout lines and tall lowercase.

Winky Sans then reads as a modern plain sans, low and smooth over a long passage.
gen-audiowide-gf-yantramanav:
Audiowide's curves stay as thick as a drawn thread, giving its tile-like glyphs a futuristic, wire-bent look.

Yantramanav reads as a plain sans, with spacious terminal gaps and huddled, tall letters.
gen-audiowide-plus-jakarta-sans:
Futuristic tiles, wide grout lines, no stroke shifts at all.

Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a monoline sans-serif with well-separated curve endings, so a longer passage would read modern and precise beneath Audiowide's taller lowercase.
gen-cinzel-decorative-fs-amulya: Amulya reads as a contemporary sans with generous gaps in its curves, modern and open. And Cinzel Decorative stands over it, refined and commanding, with widely spaced capitals and a mild shimmer of weight changes.
gen-cinzel-decorative-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, its sans line looping like spaghetti with curves left unfinished. And Cinzel Decorative does the commanding, widely spaced capital work, while Chillax handles the easygoing part.
